description:
Have you ever wondered why your prayers don't seem to be answered? Is God ignoring You? In this presentation, Pastor Mark Finley studies the intricacies of prayer and discovers the potential barriers that might be hindering your connection with the God. From the heartwarming stories of answered prayers to the profound lessons from the scriptures, journey with us as we explore the reasons behind unanswered prayers and the power of faith, patience, and perseverance. Learn how to align your prayers with God's will, the importance of self-reflection, and the significance of praying with genuine intent. Join Pastor Mark as he uncovers the transformative power of prayer and the boundless love of God. Stay tuned till the end for a special segment on the impact of intercessory prayers and why praying for others can be a game-changer.
